narrative.intro: Thalle Construction has obligated $1.9B in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Obligations are up 572.6% year over year, driven by three awards that average $640M each. Yearly obligations show a jump in FY26 after smaller totals in prior years: FY21 $167M, FY22 $213M, FY23 $16.1M, FY24 $366M, and FY25 $285M. The Department of Defense is the dominant buyer, accounting for $1.9B of obligations. Other activity includes the Department of the Interior at $239K. Contracting falls mainly under Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction at $1.9B, with a smaller presence in Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction at $239K. These figures reflect current fiscal year to date totals and the concentration of spend in heavy civil engineering work with a single large buyer driving most obligations.

sections.heading: Who are Thalle Construction's main federal customers?
sections.body: The Department of Defense obligated $1.9B to Thalle Construction in FY2026 to date. The Department of the Interior obligated $239K. Those two agencies account for the named federal buying activity this fiscal year to date.

sections.heading: What types of work does Thalle Construction perform for the government?
sections.body: Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction accounts for $1.9B of Thalle Construction's obligations in FY2026 to date. Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction accounts for $239K. The obligation pattern shows a strong focus on heavy civil engineering work.

faq.q: How much does Thalle Construction make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Thalle Construction has obligated $1.9B in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. The company won three awards this fiscal year to date, with an average award size of $640M and year-over-year obligations up 572.6%.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Thalle Construction?
faq.a: The Department of Defense is the primary buyer, obligating $1.9B to Thalle Construction this fiscal year to date. The Department of the Interior also appears as a buyer with $239K in obligations.

faq.q: What does Thalle Construction sell to the government?
faq.a: Thalle Construction sells heavy civil engineering services, with Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction accounting for $1.9B in obligations this fiscal year to date. Thalle Construction also has work in Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction totaling $239K.
